t: You're at Victoria Underground station, the third busiest on the network. It's really two stations in one, built more than a century apart. The older section serves the Circle and District lines, and the later one serves the Victoria line, with two ticket halls and a link between them. It sits right beside the mainline station. The name comes from Queen Victoria, who reigned from 1837 to 1901, longer than any monarch before her, and whose sixty-three years gave their name to the Victorian era.
